name: Arugal's Folly
summary: In Pyrewood Village, Dalar Dawnweaver seeks the magic binding its people to a curse. He needs their enchanted shackles to study Archmage Arugal's work and understand their transformation into worgen.

sections.title: The Dual Lives of Pyrewood
sections.body: South of the Sepulcher, Pyrewood Village lives two lives. By day, its fearful and insular residents seem like ordinary human peasants. At twilight, their human forms break apart and become savage Moonrage worgen. Then they roam the streets under Arugal's sway. Dalar Dawnweaver seeks the arcane bindings behind this horror.

sections.title: Shattering the Shackles
sections.body: Dalar Dawnweaver needs enchanted Pyrewood Shackles from the transformed townsfolk. Their magic holds Pyrewood in thrall and carries the lingering sorcery of Arugal's failed wards. By studying it, the Forsaken mage hopes to understand the beastly transformation and find a way to bring down the rogue archmage of Shadowfang Keep.

faq.q: Why do the people of Pyrewood Village turn into worgen at night?
faq.answer: Archmage Arugal's enchantments keep Pyrewood's people human by day, through illusion or a dormant state. At night, they become Moonrage worgen under his control.

The Pyrewood Shackles are enchanted bindings worn by Pyrewood's cursed residents. Arugal used them in his magic over the town, and Dalar Dawnweaver studies their lingering power to learn about the curse.
Dalar Dawnweaver is a Forsaken mage stationed at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. He leads the Forsaken's magical study of Archmage Arugal's summoned worgen.

faq.q: Does finishing this quest cure Pyrewood Village?
faq.answer: No. The shackles give Dalar Dawnweaver insight into Arugal's magic, but Pyrewood's curse still holds the village in perpetual torment.

faq.q: How does Arugal control the villagers?
faq.answer: Arugal bound the villagers to his will with reckless enchantments and enchanted shackles. They become beasts that guard the way to his domain at Shadowfang Keep.

faq.q: What happens after completing the Arugal's Folly quest chain?
faq.answer: The Arugal's Folly chain ends with this assignment. What the Forsaken have learned lets them assess the threat of Shadowfang Keep and plan Arugal's downfall.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you may view Pyrewood with cold fascination and ruthless pragmatism. Dismantling Arugal's enchantments could secure southern Silverpine.
As a mage, you know Arugal's shackles warn how Kirin Tor sorcery can descend into madness when joined with otherworldly summoned beasts.
As a member of the Horde, you help secure shackles that can break Arugal's mystical hold over the road south toward the Greymane Wall.
